Date: Wed, 22 Aug 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Quick onramp sync? Noticed BrightFolio usage spike

Hi Alyssa,

I saw BrightFolio crossed one of our self-serve usage tiers this morning — congrats on the momentum. I wanted to offer a short, practical onramp so your engineers can get predictable inference performance while you scale. Typical agenda: quick account validation, a short review of recent call patterns (latency/cost hotspots), and one or two config suggestions you can apply immediately.

Would a 20-minute technical sync work this week? I have these windows (PDT):
- Thu 8/24 10:00–10:30
- Thu 8/24 15:00–15:30
- Fri 8/25 09:30–10:00

If none of those fit, tell me two times and I’ll make it work. I’ll include a brief usage snapshot and a one-page runbook for the session.

Thanks — I’ll keep it light and practical.

Cheers,
Marcus Lin
SDR, Redwood Inference
marcus@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0123
